name: Blue Dream | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Reload)
description:
DIAMONDS INSIDE
Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market.
BLUE DREAM
With a tantalizing twist of berry undertones, Blue Dream is like a flavor-packed adventure for your taste buds. But that's not all – it's also your ultimate ticket to a stress-free joyride. Say hello to bliss and wave goodbye to stress, all while savoring a wild ride of vibrant flavors.
